info.title: General Translation API
info.description:
Translate content and manage projects with the General Translation API at `https://api.gtx.dev`.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`. Each endpoint lists its required permissions. Project keys (`gtx-api-`) access one project; Organization keys (`gtx-org-`) access projects in one Organization.

Project-scoped requests take the project from the path. `gt-project-id` applies only to routes without a project ID in the path, such as legacy routes, where project keys default to their own project and Organization keys require it. Discovery endpoints need no project ID. Organization-scoped requests use the Organization ID in the path. You must have access to the selected project or Organization.
